_comment: Daily map events (PLAN.md). Hours are game hours (divided by world speed). Every `everyHours` from the start of a run (the first after its first day), an event rises on passable open land `range.min` to `range.max` hexes from one of the players' villages, and goes after `lastsHours` unless an army is already on its way to it. `kinds` are picked by weight. captives: a camp (kind 'captives') of `guards` of the land's front, more each day (x 1 + `growthPerDay` x (day - 1)), holding captives: freeing them (clearing the camp) brings, with chance `unitsChance`, `count` (+ `countPerDay` a day) of one of `units` into the army that freed them, or else `resources` (x 1 + `growthPerDay` x (day - 1)) carried home with it; it doesn't grow, join hordes or ambush caravans. ruin: a hard ancient site (sites.json) watched by `guardianFactor` times its usual guardians, whose resources are worth `lootFactor` times as much.
